"Someone like You" is a song recorded by English singer-songwriter Adele.
She and Dan Wilson wrote and produced the track for her second studio album, 21 (2011).
XL Recordings released the song as the second single from the album on 24 January 2011 (the same day the album was released) in the United Kingdom and on 9 August 2011 in the United States.
21 is the second studio album by the English singer-songwriter Adele.
It was released on 24 January 2011 in Europe by XL Recordings and on 22 February 2011 in North America by Columbia Records.
The album was named after the age of the singer during its production.
